## EVIDENCE

All **18 tests** pass (0.003s). The test suite covers:

| Category | Tests | What's verified |
|---|---|---|
| Basic correctness | `TestNew`, `TestMallocFreeSingle` | Pool size rounding, allocate+free round-trip |
| Power-of-two sizes | `TestMallocExactPowerOfTwo` | Every exact power-of-two from 1 to 2048 |
| Non-power-of-two | `TestMallocNonPowerOfTwo` | 300 rounds up to 512 |
| Edge inputs | `TestMallocTooLarge`, `TestMallocZeroOrNegative`, `TestFreeNil` | Oversized, zero, negative, nil |
| Multiple allocations | `TestMultipleAllocations` | Exhaust pool with 8×256, then verify OOM on 9th |
| Coalescing | `TestBuddyCoalesceSimple`, `TestBuddyCoalesceChain`, `TestBuddyBoundaryCoalesce` | 2→1 coalesce, chain coalesce up the tree, XOR buddy formula |
| Non-buddy blocks | `TestNoCoalesceNonBuddy` | Freeing a block whose buddy is still allocated does not merge |
| Fragmentation | `TestFragmentationReuse`, `TestAlternatingFreeCoalesce` | Sub-block reuse, interleaved free order still coalesces fully |
| Internal fragmentation | `TestInternalFragmentation` | 1025-byte alloc rounds to 2048, 1023 bytes wasted but accounted |
| Memory integrity | `TestPointerCalculations` | Write/read-back through returned pointer |
| Stress | `TestRandomAllocFree` | 100 random-sized alloc/free cycles, full pool recoverable |
| Non-power-of-two pool | `TestNonPowerOfTwoPool` | 3000-byte request → 4096-byte pool |
| Exhaustive small | `TestExhaustiveSmallAllocs` | 2048 allocations of 1 byte, verify OOM, free all, get 2048 back |
